zh.title: 成品通过之前，先问哪些检查进入了分母
zh.summary: 一个通过的计划加一个没有成绩的计划，仍可能得到成品通过；交付证据需要保留覆盖范围与漏项。

en.title: Before calling a product passed, ask which checks entered the denominator
en.summary: A passed plan plus an ungraded plan can still yield a product pass; delivery evidence needs coverage and omission records.
